description: If a is not at most b in a Boolean algebra, some ultrafilter contains a and omits b.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.separates_not_le.{u} {B : Type u} [BooleanAlgebra B] (a b : B) (h : ¬a ≤ b) :
  ∃ U, Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.IsUltrafilter U ∧ a ∈ U ∧ b ∉ U
